phases.name: Mobilise
phases.description: Site set-up, survey control and clearing.

phases.name: Traffic stage 1
phases.description: Close lanes and install temporary traffic management so work can start in the corridor.

phases.name: Utilities
phases.description: Divert and prove existing services before the ground is opened.

phases.name: Earthworks
phases.description: Bulk cut and fill; cut feeds fill project-wide.

phases.name: Drainage and ducts
phases.description: Trenching, pipe, chambers and cable ducts below the pavement.

phases.name: Structures
phases.description: Piles, caps, piers, abutments, bearings, beams, deck, parapets, culverts and retaining walls.

phases.name: Traffic stage 2
phases.description: Switch traffic onto the completed carriageway so the rest can be built.

phases.name: Pavement
phases.description: Subgrade, subbase, base, kerbs and asphalt.

phases.name: Finishing
phases.description: Markings, signs, guardrail, lighting, landscape and building fit-out.

steps.name: Traffic management stage 1: close lane and set cones
steps.description: Closing a lane costs public goodwill every week it stays closed.

steps.name: Divert or protect existing utility
steps.description: Must be proven clear before earthworks in the same zone, or a strike is on the cards.

steps.name: Place and compact fill
steps.description: Fill can start once cutting has started project-wide: hauled cut material feeds the embankments.

steps.name: Drive or bore pile
steps.description: Needs a piling rig on a stable platform; integrity test is a hold point.

steps.name: Form, reinforce and pour pier or column
Pour approach slab or base slab
Set bridge bearings
steps.description: 10 week lead; beams cannot land until the bearings are on the piers.

steps.name: Lift precast beam (night closure)
steps.description: Crane plus night road closure. The riskiest step on the job.

steps.name: Erect steel girder, gantry or member
Set pump, cabinet or equipment item
Install miscellaneous element
steps.description: Default step for any element no rule matched. Shows up in the authoring feedback list.

steps.name: Traffic management stage 2: switch traffic
steps.description: Traffic moves to the completed carriageway; the old lane is released for pavement.

steps.name: Place asphalt base and binder
steps.description: Needs a paver. Temperature and rain sensitive.

steps.name: Roof, cladding and covering of small building

gates.name: Traffic stage 1 before works in corridor
gates.description: Lane closure and temporary traffic management in place in the zone before anyone digs.

gates.name: Formation proven before drainage
gates.description: Cut and fill tested to formation before trenches go in. Storey scope because drains sit on the underground storey while earthworks are on ground level; the underground storey also holds utilities and traffic stage 1, which therefore precede drainage there.

gates.name: Structures complete before traffic switch
gates.description: Zone gate: structures in a zone are inspected before later work there. The stage 2 switch itself sits in the live-traffic zones, so it also waits for the bridge deck project-wide through its predecessor rules.

gates.name: Traffic switched before pavement
gates.description: Zone gate: pavement waits for traffic stage 2 tasks in its zone; the project-wide wait for the switch is a predecessor rule on CIV-SUBGRADE-PREP.

gates.name: Pavement inspected before finishing
gates.description: Base and wearing course density and ride checks before markings, signs and lighting.

gates.name: All finishing done before handover
gates.description: Project-wide gate: lighting cabling tested and pavement signed off.

sequence_cards.name: Bridge span recipe
sequence_cards.description: Piles, caps, piers and abutments, bearings, beams (night closure), deck, parapets, then pavement and finishing.

sequence_cards.name: Road segment recipe
sequence_cards.description: Chainage segment: traffic stage, utilities, earthworks, drainage, subgrade and base, kerbs, asphalt, finishing.

sequence_cards.name: Culvert recipe
sequence_cards.description: Trench, precast units, headwalls and backfill, then pavement over the crossing.
